intro_verbatim: This chapter records announcements made after the meeting on 14 October 2026 that bear directly on statements in this report. Each is taken from a public source, which is named, and none formed part of what was presented in Lisbon.

items.label: Tabrexaban in atrial fibrillation.
items.text_verbatim: At the meeting Halden Pharmaceuticals reported that OSPREY-AF had met its primary endpoint and that major bleeding was "nearly halved", with full results embargoed. According to a company release dated 24 October 2026, the rate of stroke or systemic embolism was 1.21% per year with tabrexaban against 1.16% with the comparator (hazard ratio 1.04, within the non-inferiority margin), major bleeding was 1.9% against 3.1% per year, and discontinuation for adverse events was 4.2% against 4.0%. These figures were read in a syndicated copy of the release and have not been confirmed against the company's own publication; they should be confirmed with Halden before publication.
items.relates_to: What Halden Pharmaceuticals reported at the meeting: that OSPREY-AF had met its primary endpoint and that major bleeding was "nearly halved", with full results embargoed.

items.label: EBW-100 in Danon disease.
items.text_verbatim: On 20 October 2026 Ebbwater Genetics published 24-month data showing stabilisation of left ventricular wall thickness in 5 of 7 treated patients. The slide shown at the meeting stated 6 of 6 evaluable patients at 12 months.
items.relates_to: The slide shown at the meeting, which stated 6 of 6 evaluable patients at 12 months.

sections.heading: Regulatory position at the date of this report

items.label: Tovacamten.
items.text_verbatim: On 28 October 2026 Thornbury Pharma stated that the US regulator had accepted its filing for tovacamten with priority review, with a target action date of 12 March 2027. The product is not approved in any jurisdiction.
items.notes: A second date is mentioned: target action date of 12 March 2027. The text does not name which statement in the report this bears on.

items.label: Harrowgate Therapeutics.
items.text_verbatim: The company has stated that it plans a rolling submission later in 2026 for its gene therapy in Fabry cardiomyopathy. Nothing is approved.
items.notes: No date of the company statement is given on this page. The only timing mentioned is the planned submission timing: "later in 2026".
